entries.mechanism:
Alabama's broad-based categorical eligibility (SNAP state option;
PolicyEngine models gross screen x1.3 FPL, x2.0 for elderly/disabled
households, at 2026-01 per gov/hhs/tanf/non_cash parameters) is not in
the composed us-al/snap/fy-2026 program, which applies only the standard
federal tests. Every selected row is verified per-row against axiom's
persisted output surface: household gross income sits inside the band
above the federal 130 percent limit the composed program applies and at
or below the state's BBCE screen, verified against axiom's own computed
gross income and limit. Axiom-side modeling boundary, tracked for
encoding in rulespec-us#1098.

households, at 2026-01 per gov/hhs/tanf/non_cash parameters) is not in

federal tests. Every selected row is verified per-row against axiom's
persisted output surface: the household passes axiom's gross test and
fails only the net-income test, which the state's BBCE waives. Axiom-
side modeling boundary, tracked for encoding in rulespec-us#1098.

The true-January regeneration preserves all three selected benefit rows
and their paired eligibility-right-only rows. Their PolicyEngine benefits
moved from 201.3240763346354, 23.973597208658855, and
234.62408447265625 to 196.39996337890625, 23.84000015258789, and
229.699951171875, respectively; that material amount movement does not
change the eligibility-boundary evidence.

Reverified on PolicyEngine 4.18.9, PolicyEngine-US 1.767.3, and PolicyEngine-Core 3.30.3. The exact-household signature and explicit K-12 counterfactual reproduce the mechanism: PolicyEngine excludes all earnings of an imputed K-12 member age 17 or younger without requiring the co-resident-parent or parental-control condition in 7 CFR 273.9(c)(7). The sole minor is a valid household under 273.1(a)(1), but wages count under 273.9(b)(1)(i), so Axiom correctly fails the income gate and returns zero benefit. The true-January regeneration preserves the same four paired benefit/eligibility selectors. In case-id order, PolicyEngine benefits moved from 296.8949788411458, 299.66998291015625, 150.64496866861978, and 299.66998291015625 to 294.70001220703125, 298.0, 148.59999084472656, and 298.0; Axiom remains ineligible with zero benefit for all four, so the amount movement does not change the evidenced classification.
